policies.title: HR Policy
policies.body:
This is a starter draft. Replace it with the approved Search Engineers HR policy.

## Working hours
- Office hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Saturday.
- Sundays and the 2nd and 4th Saturdays of each month are weekly offs.
- Sign in to TaskDesk when you start and sign out when you finish. These times are your attendance record.
- Sign ins after 10:00 AM are marked late. Three late sign ins in a month count as half a day of casual leave.

## Conduct
- Treat colleagues and clients with respect in person, on calls and on chat.
- Client data, logins and reports are confidential. Never share them outside the team.

## Probation and confirmation
- New on role staff complete a 3 month probation period with a review at the end.
- Associates work on agreed scopes and follow the same conduct and confidentiality rules.

## Equipment and access
- Laptops and paid tool accounts belong to the company and are returned on exit.
- Shared logins are kept under Credentials. Ask the admin if you need access.

policies.title: Leave Policy
policies.body:
This is a starter draft. Replace it with the approved Search Engineers leave policy.

## Leave each calendar year
- Casual leave: 12 days
- Sick leave: 12 days
- Earned leave: 15 days
- Restricted holidays: choose up to 2 days from the restricted holiday list
- Comp off: one day for each full working day on a weekly off or public holiday, used within 60 days

## How to apply
- Apply in TaskDesk under Leave at least 3 working days in advance for planned leave.
- For sick leave, apply on the same day before 10:00 AM and inform your lead.
- All leave is approved by the admin.

## Before you go
- Update your open tasks and add notes so your lead can reassign them.
- Hand over client calls and deadlines that fall during your leave.

## Holidays
- Sundays and the 2nd and 4th Saturdays are weekly offs. Public holidays follow the company holiday calendar.
- Restricted holidays are personal choices and need approval like any other leave.
